page.layout: One page of text, one column, with no margin notes. At the top: running head "Jo. Morinus" and page number 168. Below: the continuation of a letter, a date line, the heading "EPIST. XIV.", an argument summary, and the salutation. At the lower right: catchword "Erube-".

main_text.p: comparatione ista judicabo: non refert è qua parte Pentateuchi illud extrahas, neque opus est, ut in notando capite labores; facile unde evulsum sit conjiciam, atque iterum illud cum Pentateucho meo conferam, & comparationis sententiam ad te rescribam; spero plane, vir Nobilissime atque literarum sacrarum amantissime, te precibus mei aliquid concessurum, beneficiumque, quo me jam devinctum habes novo beneficio cumulaturum. Vale atque ut me plurimum ames, etiam atque etiam velim.
main_text.head: EPIST. XIV.
main_text.p: Petrus à Valle Peregrinus de suo exemplari M.S. Pentateuchi Samaritani, quid de Samaritanorum & Carraim sectis in Asia didicerit, fusius declarat.

p.i: Rev. Patri atque eruditissimo Domino meo Patri Joanni Morino, Congregationis Oratorii Presbytero Petrus à Valle Peregrinus S. P. D[?].

page.notes: The ink blot at the end of the salutation covers the letter "D" of "S. P. D."; the reading is uncertain. The running head is printed in small capitals. The catchword is hyphenated and kept as printed.
